messages.subject: ISA R workshop
messages.body_plain:
The ISA is planning an R workshop.
We still haven't decided wether to make it begginers-oriented or
advanced.
Being statisticians, we are polling in order to decide. Please share
your opinon at the ISA site.
http://www.statistics.org.il/?p=250

messages.subject: Multiple comparisons package
messages.body_plain:
I am proud to present my first R package.
Given a set of pvalues, it does FDR control and p-value adjustment
using several methods. It also has a plot method.

https://sites.google.com/site/johnros/Home/mcp-project-package

Enjoy

messages.subject: Plotting packages
messages.body_plain:
I assume most use the base graphics package. I've recently discovered
the more powerful lattice and ggplot2 packages and was curious if
someone has enough experience with them to recommend one?
